finding.comment: The audit job stays pinned to an immutable SHA, so inherited secrets remain scoped to the pinned auditor; the claimed mutable-branch exposure is not present.

files.patch:
--- a/.github/workflows/audit.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/audit.yml
@@ -2,5 +2,5 @@
 jobs:
   audit:
-    uses: acme/security-kit/.github/workflows/audit.yml@f3a4b5c6d7e8f90112a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3
+    uses: acme/security-kit/.github/workflows/audit.yml@a4b5c6d7e8f90112a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4
     secrets: inherit
